Thanks for the report.

This looks like it may be the same problem as `electron/electron#50393`, `electron/electron#50776`. If it is, adding your details there helps more than a separate issue. If it is different, a short note on what differs helps a maintainer decide.

To look into this, a maintainer needs a way to reproduce it. Could you make a minimal example in [Electron Fiddle](https://www.electronjs.org/fiddle), save it as a gist and add the link here?

<sub>Automated first-pass triage. It can only add labels and comment; a maintainer makes every decision, including whether this issue stays open.</sub>

triage: kinds=similar,need-repro refs=#50393,#50776
interpretation: Scorer fields represent proposed actions, not GitHub writes.
explanation: The report describes V8 startup crashes under MAS and supplies traces and conditions but no runnable sample; two earlier reports match the SIGTRAP worker-thread crash under TestFlight.
